system.name: FyndGames Exit Intent System
system.description: Single-tenant gamification popup triggered by exit intent on cart abandonment.

components.name: Storefront Injector Script
components.responsibility: Detect exit intent, check cart, open game iframe.
components.logic: IF (mouse_leave AND user_has_cart AND !game_played_session) THEN open_iframe(frontend_url + '?mode=popup&context=' + user_context)

components.name: Game Frontend
components.responsibility: Render game, handle gameplay, display reward.
modifications: Auto-login/create mock user based on context.

components.name: Gamification Backend
components.responsibility: Manage sessions, issue rewards, log to Boltic.

data_flows.data: Cart ID, UserContext (Name/ID inferred from Store SDK)

identity_logic: Username = `guest_${timestamp}_${random}` OR derived from Store SDK context if available. Backend treats this as a valid user for the session.
